model_description: GPT-3.5-turbo - the model that powered ChatGPT at launch
notes: GPT-3.5-turbo is the same model architecture used in ChatGPT when it launched Nov 30, 2022
This model's recommendations represent what users would have received from ChatGPT in late 2022 through early 2023
The model was trained on data up to September 2021, so its name recommendations reflect pre-2022 popularity patterns
Treatment period for diff-in-diff: 2023+ (first full year after ChatGPT launch)

identification_strategy.first_stage_variation: chatgpt_freq - how many times the model recommended each name across queries
